description: Update the throttleRAF utility function to properly preserve and use the last arguments passed to it during animation frame throttling. Remove the unnecessary trailing option from the throttle configuration since it's not needed for this specific use case.
functional_requirements: Modify the throttleRAF function to capture and use the most recent arguments when the throttled function executes
Remove the trailing option from throttle configuration in all relevant throttleRAF calls
Ensure the fix applies consistently across the codebase where throttleRAF is used
Maintain the existing throttling behavior while ensuring argument preservation works correctly
